description: Local custom homebuilder and former state senator has announced he is running for the Idaho Senate in the May 19, 2026, Republican primary election with a goal of eliminating all property taxes and controlling Idaho's government spending.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Herndon for Idaho, Paul Herndon, Treasurer
title: SCOTT HERNDON ANNOUNCES BID FOR IDAHO STATE SENATE DISTRICT 1 - Scott Herndon
